anime.name: Roronoa Zoro
anime.creator: Eiichiro Oda

anime.why_dasean: Loyal to the death. Never backs down. Gets lost but always arrives. The man who would become the world's greatest swordsman. Stoic exterior, lion heart inside.

anime.color_feel: forest green, steel grey, blood red, ocean blue

anime.name: Piccolo
anime.creator: Akira Toriyama
anime.who: The Namekian warrior. Started as Goku's enemy, became Gohan's mentor and father figure.
anime.why_dasean: The ultimate dad who wasn't supposed to be a dad. Trained the next generation. Green warrior with a cape. Stoic but secretly loves his family. Would die for his people — and HAS, multiple times.
anime.signature: Green skin, purple gi, white cape, turban, Special Beam Cannon
anime.color_feel: Namekian green, purple, white cape, golden ki blast
anime.quote: Do you really think I'd let you destroy everything I've worked to protect?
